hpi: Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is the most common benign tumor in men. It is important to recognize that BPH is not a precursor to prostate cancer, although it can lead to urinary symptoms that may mimic those of prostate cancer. The diagnosis of BPH is made clinically, and treatment is based on the severity of symptoms. Patients with mild symptoms may be managed with watchful waiting, while those with moderate to severe symptoms may require medical or surgical intervention.
